intent: Scroll story: a pinned product panel that changes through four choreographed states as steps scroll past. Monochrome, dark first, one accent.

stack.animation: motion/react (useScroll, useSpring, variants, motion values for counting figures) + IntersectionObserver

layout.header: eyebrow + two-tone heading (8 cols) + intro (4 cols)
layout.desktop: panel sticky top-0 h-screen in 6 cols; steps ~80vh each on a rail in 6 cols
layout.mobile: each step renders its panel state inline

color.approach: black, white and greys; one accent prop for progress, the primary action and the money that's yours
color.accent: #ff8a4c (prop): rail fill, reached step rings, eyebrow dot, running dot, timer button, Send invoice, paid ring, Paid timeline dot, the Yours pot
color.tokens: one PALETTE object per theme written to --fs-* CSS variables

motion.header: eyebrow, heading, intro rise 12px out of an 8px blur at 0 / 60 / 140ms when the header enters
motion.steps: each step's copy reveals once at 25% in view (rise out of blur)
motion.panel: the pinned panel rises in at 220ms; its first state plays once it has; states cross-fade with a 16px offset and 4px blur over 0.5s
motion.stateChoreography: every time a state becomes active, its blocks replay: container at 80ms, then text and rows at 60ms steps (rise out of blur), figures count up from zero out of a blur from 160ms over 0.9s, bars and pots fill from their base from 450ms (0.8s). Track: the clock fast-forwards from 00:00:00 then ticks each second. Invoice: line items stagger, the total counts, Send rises last. Paid: the accent ring draws round, then the tick draws, the amount counts, the timeline staggers. Set aside: pots rise, then fill, amounts count.
motion.activeStep: IntersectionObserver band through the viewport middle; inactive titles 35%, bodies 30% (wide); rings up to active take the accent
motion.implementation: figures are motion values rendered as text (no per-frame React state); one timer for the clock, always cleared
motion.reducedMotion: short fades only, instant swaps, figures final, no spring on the rail
motion.navigation: rail markers are buttons (hover 1.1, press 0.95) that smooth-scroll their step to centre; prev/next arrows under the panel; step name slides in with blur

responsive.narrow: no sticky; each step shows its own panel state inline and plays it at 35% in view

accessibility: each step is a section with a heading

steps: Track: Hit start. Forget it’s running.
Paid: Paid by card, bank or a firm reminder.
Set aside: Tax money goes where you can’t spend it.

avoid: the accent on labels, eyebrows or every bar
